NYMPH_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_THOUGHT.title: Thought
NYMPH_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_THOUGHT.descrip: Gain 1 whenever you play a card. At the first threshold, become Confused. At the second threshold, become Obstructed.
NYMPH_DURABILITY.title: Durability
NYMPH_DURABILITY.description: Whenever this card is played, lose 1 Durability. At 0, remove this card from your deck.
NYMPH_CARDPILE_INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration Pile
NYMPH_CARDPILE_INSPIRATION.description: Stores Inspiration cards separately. At the start of combat, choose 1 Inspiration from the entire pile to add to your Hand, or skip.
